A body mount that is harder than the original transmits more road noise into the cabin; one that is softer lets the body move. We match the load and deflection, not just the shape.
Natural rubber, because it is a fatigue part
A mount is loaded and unloaded every time the vehicle moves. Natural rubber has the best fatigue resistance we mix — we move to neoprene only where the position is exposed enough to need it.
The insert is moulded in, not fitted
We bond rubber to steel in-house, so the sleeve is part of the pad rather than pressed into it afterwards. Nothing to work loose and nothing to corrode at the joint.

Margo Rubber Products is an independent manufacturer. We are not affiliated with, authorised by or endorsed by any vehicle manufacturer. Vehicle names and OE numbers are used to identify fitment only.
Fitment lists and product photography are available to distributors on request. Tell us the variant and model year and we will confirm the part number, the position and the set quantity.
What is the minimum order quantity for this part?

We supply in bulk. The minimum run is 10,000 pieces per part number, per compound. That suits a distributor or a fleet operator rather than a workshop — if you need smaller quantities, we will point you to a stockist. Prototype and first-article lots sit outside the minimum.
Can you match a competitor specification or reverse-engineer an existing part?

Yes — that is what this part is. Send a sample, ideally an unused one. A mount taken off a vehicle has crept and measures thinner than it was moulded, so copying its dimensions reproduces a part that is already part-worn. We match the original load and deflection, not the worn shape.
What file formats do you accept for drawings?
PDF, DWG and DXF — but for this part you do not need a drawing. Tell us the vehicle, the variant, the model year and the mount position, or send a sample pad, and that is a complete specification.
Do you provide material test reports with each shipment?

Yes. Material test reports, dimensional inspection sheets and a certificate of conformance ship with every consignment. Hardness, tensile to ASTM D412 and compression set to ASTM D395 Method B are tested in-house, and load-deflection is checked on batch samples against the original specification.
What are your payment and delivery terms for international orders?

TT and LC accepted, discussed per order. Ex-works Nashik or FOB Nhava Sheva. Commercial invoice, packing list and certificate of origin are issued with every consignment. Parts are packed and labelled by part number and set quantity.
